title: fix(studio): the dataset designer edits a dimension's and a measure's synonyms and description
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWQkB6gV48HrfG4nT2Zfgzj)_

Fixes #32943

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 数据集设计器里，每个维度和度量行的「高级」展开区新增「同义词」（逗号分隔）和「描述」两个输入框，回显已存的值，编辑后存到该成员上。
- 为什么改：18.4 的数据集词汇（同义词、描述）只能通过 API 写，AI 助手读得到、作者在 Studio 里却看不到也改不了。
- 风险与回滚：只动设计器界面，不改 spec 和服务端；清空输入框会删掉该键，不写空数组或空串；回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`DatasetMemberVocabulary.tsx`（解析与写入规则）、`DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`（两处挂载）、`DatasetDefaultInspector.test.tsx` 末尾的新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：在 Studio 打开任一数据集，展开某个度量的「高级」，应看到「同义词」「描述」及「最多 20 个，每个最多 60 个字符」的说明；填入后保存再刷新，值仍在。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#4）审过。数据集设计器里每个维度和度量的"高级"区新增同义词和描述两个框，文案直接取规格自带的数据集表单（已有中文），没有新增文案键；清空即删除该键，不会存空列表或空字符串；描述按当前语言只改对应条目。上限不在前端拦，由保存时的数据集校验统一判。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

## What changes

`DatasetDefaultInspector` replaces the spec's `datasetForm` for a dataset, so it never drew the `synonyms` and `description` row properties the form declares on dimensions and measures (ADR-0149 D1). Each dimension and measure row's Advanced disclosure now draws both, through a new sibling component `inspectors/DatasetMemberVocabulary.tsx`:

- **Copy from the spec, localized through the existing overlay.** The label and help text are read from `datasetForm`'s own `dimensions.synonyms` / `measures.description` rows, run through `localizeMetadataForm(…, 'dataset', locale)`, the `metadataForms.dataset` overlay the spec-driven panels already use (its zh-CN rows for these four properties already exist in `metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`). No catalogue key is added anywhere, so `Clause-②` stays `no` and the limits the author reads are the spec's sentence.
- **Synonyms**: a text box split on a comma (ASCII `,` or full-width `，`, the separator the spec's help text names), each word trimmed, empty pieces dropped. The box keeps its own text while it still parses to the stored list (a trailing `, ` stays on screen) and re-reads the stored list when it changes elsewhere.
- **Description**: an `I18nLabel`, so the box reads and writes the designer locale's entry through `pickLocalized` / `setLocalized` / `clearLocalized`, as the report inspector does for its label: editing one locale keeps the others, clearing removes only that entry.
- **Writes** go through `writeMemberVocabulary`: an emptied value removes the key, so a member never gains `synonyms: []` or `description: ''`.
- **No client-side limit.** The 20-word / 60-character bounds, the one-member-per-word rule and the 500-character description stay `DatasetSchema`'s to judge; the save path already surfaces a schema refusal (banner plus inline issue). The designer writes a duplicate or over-limit list as typed.

## Tests

New top-level `describe('DatasetDefaultInspector member vocabulary (synonyms + description)')` in the shared harness file `DatasetDefaultInspector.test.tsx` (9 cases). The harness holds the draft the way the host does (each patch merged onto it), so every pin reads the edit back from the draft the save sends.

- measure row and dimension row: Synonyms and Description prefilled from the stored dataset, help text with the limits shown;
- an edit to each kind saves both keys on that member (the other kind untouched);
- a trailing separator stays on screen and writes nothing until the list changes;
- CONTROL: a member without vocabulary saves unchanged when another of its fields is edited (no `synonyms` or `description` key appears);
- clearing both boxes removes the keys;
- a duplicate or over-limit list is written as typed (the verdict is the save's);
- zh-CN designer: the localized label and help text show, and editing an inline description map changes only the `zh-CN` entry; clearing it leaves `{ en }`.

Ablation (committed fix first, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, restored blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): replacing the Synonyms control's write `onCommit={(next) => onWrite('synonyms', next)}` with a no-op turns 5 of the 9 pins red (both save pins, the trailing-separator pin, the clear pin, the as-typed pin); the 4 read/description-only pins stay green, as predicted.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order expected the strings to come from `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`; that table moved into the `@object-ui/i18n` studio namespace. Reading the spec form through the existing `metadataForms.dataset` overlay instead needed no key in either place, so no file outside the claimed surface was touched.
- The ideographic enumeration comma `、` is not a separator: the spec allows it inside a synonym and its help text says comma-separated. A zh author who types `阶段、销售阶段` stores one synonym; the help text's example list uses `、`, which may invite that. Noted, not changed.
- The existing dimension and measure Label boxes read `label` as a plain string, though `label` is an `I18nLabel` too; a stored inline label map shows an empty box there. Not touched here (out of this card's scope).
